title: Professional Certificate Course in Closing and Reviewing Projects
description: This course explain and elaborate Project Closure, Project Evaluation, PERT Analysis, justifying project progress, S-curves, and WBS significance.
longDescription: The course covers Project Closure concepts, including when to close a project and the steps involved in the process. You will learn about Project Evaluation and its types, PERT Analysis, techniques for justifying project progress, the use of S-curves, and the significance of WBS during Project Closure. This course will provide you with a thorough understanding of Project Closure concepts and techniques applicable to any project management role.
courseDetails: The course on Project Closure covers the key concepts and techniques required to successfully close a project. It discuss the criteria for project closure, the steps involved in the closure process, and the importance of project evaluation. The course explore PERT Analysis, techniques for justifying project progress, and the use of S-curves. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge and skills to effectively close a project and evaluate its outcomes. Following are the main topics cover in this course;
